description: Add plain text and files to a Laviya task's description (mode append, default) or replace it (mode replace). Local filePaths are uploaded to the task attachments first; images are shown inline, other files as links.

fileIDs.description: fileID values already returned by laviya_upload_task_file for the same task.

filePaths.description: Local files to upload to the task first; images are shown inline, other files as links.

items.description: Local file path (absolute, or relative to the project root). Allowed: images (png, jpg, gif, webp), pdf, txt, md, log, json, csv, xml, zip, Office files, mp4, webm, mov; max 20 MiB.

mode.description: append (default) adds to the end of the description; replace overwrites it.

text.description: Plain text; Laviya stores it as escaped HTML.

name: laviya_update_task_description
title: Update Task Description
